title: Epiphany during Jean Houston's mystery school lecture on The Cipher of Genesis

tellings.quote: somehow as I'm listening to this lecture, I got it. And I had the experience of how it happened, how God created this universe.

plain: Jeffrey Mishlove, a researcher with a doctorate who studies psychic phenomena, says he once had a sudden experience of how God created the universe. He says it came while he was listening to a lecture at the "mystery school" run by the teacher Jean Houston, on The Cipher of Genesis, a book by Carlos Suarès about the Book of Genesis. Mishlove tells it as something that happened to him: "I got it. And I had the experience of how it happened."
